newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firmer in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firmer in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was firmer against the dollar in moderate late trading on Friday.
Spot rupiah rebounded to 2,396.5/97.0 at 0905 GMT from an early low of 2,398.5. It opened at 2,395.0/96.0.
One local bank dealer said the small recovery was due to increased rupiah demand in the afternoon, lifting short-term swaps back into positive zone.
Tom/next swaps edged up to 0.25/0.30 from 0.05/0.10 points.
"Liquidity isn't really tight, but surprisingly demand increased in the afternoon," the local bank dealer said.
One local bank dealer said demand on overnight dollar deposits seemed to increase, driving market rates to 6.25 percent from 5.25 percent previously.
One-month swaps were at 9.25/9.75, two at 21.50/23.00, three at 33.0/34.0 and six at 72.00/73.00 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,382/2,574 and the conversion band 2,382/2,430 on Friday after raising them by one point on Tuesday.
The bank depreciated the rupiah by two points last week after lowering it by three points the previous week.
